notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
wmiexec.py from Impacket authenticates via SMB and executes commands through WMI, returning output without installing a persistent service. Uses legitimate Windows management channels — lower detection profile than PSExec for command execution.

=== CHAINING ===
Valid credentials from any source → wmiexec.py → OS command execution as authenticated user → enumerate → dump creds → lateral movement.

=== vs ALTERNATIVES ===
psexec.py: installs a service binary (more detectable). wmiexec.py: no persistent service, uses WMI (legitimate admin channel). smbexec.py: uses scheduled tasks. wmiexec preferred for stealth.

=== DETECTION ===
WMI command execution creates Event 4648, 4624. wmiexec spawns commands as children of WmiPrvSE.exe. EDR behavioral rules watch for unusual WmiPrvSE.exe child processes.
